title: Remote Postgres activation smoke and migration evidence package contract

activation_boundary.summary: This is future/operator-gated evidence planning only. It is not proof activation occurred and performs no remote Postgres activation, no migration execution, no live database cutover, no provisioning, no production host mutation, no compose/profile activation, and no plaintext fallback.

operator_gate.required_statement: Future remote Postgres activation smoke and migration evidence must be operator-gated, timestamped, redacted, reviewer-backed, tied to an explicit change window, bound to a redacted remote postgres endpoint identity, single migration runner, backup/restore checkpoint, rollback plan, and fix-forward criteria before any activation claim can be considered.

readiness_prerequisites.required_statement: Epic 132 remote Postgres readiness, Epic 133 DB mTLS readiness, Story 134.1 controlled activation evidence, and Story 134.2 split-deployment smoke evidence are prerequisites only and are not proof activation occurred.

minimum_evidence: Alembic current and head revision references before migration
operator approval and change-window references
remote Postgres profile/config reference without credential values
stop condition proving services do not auto-migrate on startup
single migration runner identity by role/reference only
lock/election or maintenance-window evidence proving no parallel runners
registry-api and worker services excluded from migration runner authority
pre-migration backup or managed snapshot reference
checksum or provider snapshot identity without secret material
restore checkpoint or restore-drill reference
backup retention/expiry reference
pool size and overflow limits from the bounded pool contract
pool timeout/recycle/pre-ping settings
worker count or capacity assumption used for the bounded calculation
registry-state materializer single-writer authority
registry-api read/write boundary remains non-migration-runner
no multi-writer materialized state process
registry-api read-side compatibility smoke scope
idempotency/read model uses the same approved backend reference
SQLite/local default compatibility remains documented when remote Postgres is absent
database endpoint identity by redacted label or ticket reference only
no credential values or unredacted connection strings
no production hostname or certificate subject material
rollback owner and rollback plan reference
fix-forward owner and criteria reference
database restore checkpoint selected before migration
fail-closed status if migration, smoke, backup, or redaction evidence is missing

redaction_and_secret_hygiene.policy: Evidence packages, docs, status, checker output, and artifacts must contain no plaintext secrets, credential values, token values, private key material, certificate material, unredacted connection strings, database endpoint identity beyond redacted reference labels, production host secrets, production hostnames, certificate subjects, or full secret paths.
allowed_examples: hashes or immutable image digests without secret material

non_goals: No remote Postgres activation, no live activation, and no production activation proof.

No provisioning, migration execution, production host mutation, live database cutover, compose/profile activation, credential handling, certificate material handling, plaintext fallback, runtime behavior change, deployment config change, dependency change, lockfile change, or production-state change.
No acceptance of readiness prerequisites as proof activation occurred.
